title: Test fixed minimatch without weakening ruleset observation

claims.statement: The Node 22.20.0 quality gate fails because npm audit reports two high-severity runtime findings for brace-expansion through the governance host's direct minimatch 9.0.9 dependency.
claims.evidence: npm run check and npm audit --omit=dev --json on 2026-07-25; GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg; dependency path @overlaykit/governance-host -> minimatch 9.0.9 -> brace-expansion 2.1.2

claims.statement: The governance host uses minimatch only to decide whether an observed GitHub ruleset include or exclude pattern applies to a protected ref, with brace, comment, extglob, and negation syntax disabled.
claims.evidence: tools/governance/src/github-observer.ts githubRulesetAppliesToRef and repository-wide minimatch import search on 2026-07-25

claims.statement: Registry metadata identifies minimatch 10.2.5 as compatible with Node 18, 20, and 22 or newer and dependent on brace-expansion ^5.0.5; npm audit identifies the same version as the available remediation.
claims.evidence: npm view minimatch@10.2.5 and npm audit --omit=dev --json on 2026-07-25

claims.statement: H-036: Pinning minimatch 10.2.5 in the governance host can remove the current high-severity runtime audit findings while preserving the exact fail-closed protected-ref matching semantics used by GitHub ruleset observation under Node 22.
claims.evidence: Security gate failure analysis authorized by @rodrigoteamx's repeat-the-cycle instruction on 2026-07-25

claims.statement: H-036 is supported for the tested Node 22 governance host: exact minimatch 10.2.5 with brace-expansion 5.0.8 preserved the constrained protected-ref matcher corpus, all 47 governance tests passed, and the current runtime audit reported zero vulnerabilities.
claims.evidence: Node 22.20.0 npm ls, focused githubRulesetAppliesToRef compatibility test, npm run governance:check, and npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high on 2026-07-25

claims.statement: The major-version change may alter matching behavior for patterns outside the exact literals, branch globs, reserved GitHub tokens, and disabled syntax exercised by this Slice.
This Slice does not establish a general dependency-update policy, acceptance of arbitrary GitHub ruleset syntax, product runtime behavior, or any physical Stream Deck behavior.

successCriteria.statement: The governance host pins minimatch exactly to 10.2.5 and the installed production dependency graph contains no vulnerable minimatch 9 or brace-expansion 2 path.
successCriteria.verification: package manifests, lockfile, npm ls --omit=dev, and dependency identity inspection.

successCriteria.statement: Exact protected refs, branch-name patterns, wildcards, reserved ~ALL and ~DEFAULT_BRANCH tokens, excludes, inactive enforcement, non-branch targets, and disabled brace, comment, extglob, and negation syntax retain explicit fail-closed tests.
successCriteria.verification: Focused githubRulesetAppliesToRef compatibility tests under Node 22.

successCriteria.statement: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high reports zero high or critical runtime vulnerabilities.
All governance, quality, module, packaging, and build gates pass without changing protocol, module action, feedback, evidence authority, or product behavior.
successCriteria.verification: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, and repository diff review under Node 22.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0007 records H-036, the audit evidence, compatibility boundary, and success criteria before changing the dependency.
definitionOfDone.evidence: CHG-0007 and pre-change npm audit report from 2026-07-25.

definitionOfDone.statement: The Slice changes only the governance dependency identity, lockfile, focused matcher tests, this change contract, and deterministic generated governance artifacts.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Repository diff review against CHG-0007 on 2026-07-25.

definitionOfDone.statement: H-036 is refuted or supported by focused matcher compatibility evidence and the current runtime audit, both under Node 22.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Node 22.20.0: exact minimatch 10.2.5 and brace-expansion 5.0.8 dependency path, 47 passing governance tests including the constrained matcher corpus, and npm audit reporting zero vulnerabilities on 2026-07-25.

definitionOfDone.statement: No ADR, implemented status, merge, or broader dependency policy is created before separate human evidence review and acceptance.
